title: CloudMeet: Self-hosted Calendly alternative on Cloudflare  #github
description:
Calendly is cool—but what if you could self-host it for free? Meet CloudMeet—a simple, open-source meeting scheduler that runs entirely on Cloudflare’s free tier. Connect Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, or even both at the same time. 

https://github.com/dennisklappe/CloudMeet

#github #opensource
